label: The same persistence law and reason for x leave a distinct bearer y's actuality open
paraphrase: Analyst control, attribution deferred. Two integer-time histories of one frame share the cessation law and no inducers. A bearer x has the same presence at each date and the same earlier-date reason for presence at date 1 in both histories, while a distinct bearer y is present at some date in one and at none in the other. Even the global law and the x-only reason fail to entail y's actuality.
